subject: fre
source: Cambridge IGCSE French – Foreign Language (0520) syllabus for examination in 2025–2027 and 2028–2030 (topic areas A–E and grammar list) — Cambridge International; Year 10 covers topic areas A and B and begins C, with core tenses

weeks.topic: Self, family and friends: introducing myself and my family (être, avoir)
objectives: Give name, age, birthday and nationality
Describe family members using être and avoir
Use possessive adjectives mon, ma, mes

weeks.topic: Describing people: appearance and personality (adjective agreement and position)
objectives: Describe hair, eyes and height
Use adjectives with correct agreement and position
Use très, assez and un peu

weeks.topic: Relationships with family and friends (reflexive verbs: s'entendre avec)
objectives: Describe relationships with family and friends
Use s'entendre avec and se disputer
Justify opinions with parce que

weeks.topic: Daily routine and telling the time (reflexive verbs)
objectives: Tell the time and use days, months and seasons
Describe a daily routine with reflexive verbs

weeks.topic: In the home: rooms, furniture and chores (il y a, prepositions of place)
objectives: Describe your home and bedroom
Use il y a and prepositions of place
Talk about household chores

weeks.topic: Food and drink: meals and mealtimes (partitive articles)
objectives: Name foods and drinks for each meal
Use du, de la, de l' and des correctly

weeks.topic: Shopping for food: quantities and prices (expressions of quantity)
objectives: Use numbers and prices in euros
Ask for quantities using un kilo de and une bouteille de

weeks.topic: At the café and restaurant (vouloir, pouvoir, vous)
objectives: Order food and drink politely using vous
Use vouloir and pouvoir + infinitive
Make a simple complaint

weeks.topic: Healthy living: diet, sleep and exercise (il faut, devoir)
objectives: Give advice on healthy living
Use il faut and devoir + infinitive

weeks.topic: The body, illness and the doctor's (avoir mal à)
objectives: Name parts of the body
Describe symptoms using avoir mal au, à la, aux
Understand advice from a doctor or pharmacist

weeks.topic: Leisure time: hobbies (jouer à, jouer de, faire de)
objectives: Describe hobbies and frequency
Use jouer à, jouer de and faire de correctly

weeks.topic: Sport and physical activity: last weekend (passé composé with avoir)
objectives: Describe sports and activities
Form the passé composé with avoir for regular and irregular verbs

weeks.topic: Clothes, colours and accessories (comparatives)
objectives: Describe clothes and colours with agreement
Compare items using plus … que, moins … que and aussi … que

weeks.topic: Going out: making arrangements (futur proche: aller + infinitive)
objectives: Make, accept and decline invitations
Arrange where and when to meet using the futur proche

weeks.topic: Review: self, family, home, food, health and leisure (présent and passé composé)
objectives: Revise topic vocabulary from term 1
Practise present and passé composé in short writing tasks

weeks.topic: Travel and transport (en, à and prepositions with places)
objectives: Describe how you travel and why
Buy tickets and ask about times
Use en, au, aux and à with places

weeks.topic: Past holidays (passé composé with être)
objectives: Describe a past holiday
Form the passé composé with être and agreement

weeks.topic: Accommodation: hotels, campsites and youth hostels (conditional: je voudrais)
objectives: Book a room or campsite pitch
Use je voudrais and j'aimerais
Ask about facilities

weeks.topic: Describing past experiences: the imperfect tense
objectives: Describe what places and people were like using the imperfect
Contrast imperfect and passé composé

weeks.topic: Asking for and giving directions (imperative)
objectives: Ask for and give directions
Use tu and vous imperatives

weeks.topic: My town and local services (superlatives)
objectives: Describe your town, buildings and services
Use superlatives le plus … de and le meilleur

weeks.topic: Shopping for clothes: sizes and returns (direct object pronouns)
objectives: Shop for clothes and ask for sizes
Return items and explain problems
Use le, la and les as pronouns

weeks.topic: Weather and seasons (il fait, il pleut, weather expressions)
objectives: Describe the weather and seasons
Use il fait, il pleut and il neige

weeks.topic: The environment: environmental problems (negatives: ne … plus, ne … jamais)
objectives: Describe environmental problems
Use negative structures ne … plus and ne … jamais

weeks.topic: Protecting the environment (on doit, il faut que + subjunctive)
objectives: Describe what you do to help the environment
Use il faut que with the present subjunctive

weeks.topic: Communications and technology: phones and social media (expressing opinions)
objectives: Talk about how you use technology
Give advantages and disadvantages
Use je pense que and à mon avis

weeks.topic: Mid-year exams: listening, reading and writing on topic areas A–C
objectives: Complete timed listening, reading and writing papers
Review common grammar errors

weeks.topic: The digital world: online safety (relative pronouns qui, que)
objectives: Discuss online risks and safety
Use relative pronouns qui and que

weeks.topic: People and places: countries, nationalities and compass points
objectives: Name countries and nationalities with correct agreement
Locate places using nord, sud, est and ouest

weeks.topic: The Francophone world: France, Quebec, West Africa and the Caribbean
objectives: Describe features of French-speaking countries
Compare them with Brazil

weeks.topic: Festivals and celebrations in France and the Francophone world
objectives: Describe festivals such as le 14 juillet, Noël and l'Aïd
Describe how you celebrate a festival

weeks.topic: Writing skills: messages, emails and short descriptions (Paper 4)
objectives: Write short messages covering all bullet points
Use connectives and opinions to develop answers

weeks.topic: Speaking skills: role plays (Paper 3)
objectives: Respond to role-play prompts
Ask and answer questions in tu and vous registers

weeks.topic: Measurements and materials: describing objects (en bois, en plastique)
objectives: Describe size and shape of objects
Say what objects are made of

weeks.topic: Reading strategies: cognates, faux amis and multiple-choice questions (Paper 2)
objectives: Use cognates and context to infer meaning
Avoid faux amis
Approach multiple-choice reading tasks

weeks.topic: End-of-year exams: all four skills on Year 10 topics
objectives: Complete listening, reading, speaking and writing assessments
Reflect on progress in each skill

weeks.topic: Review: tenses and topic vocabulary from Year 10
objectives: Correct errors from end-of-year exams
Consolidate présent, passé composé, imparfait and futur proche
